# Unlocking Nodes
Unlocking nodes is how you progress through an artifact’s layers and extract research points.
## Process 1. Select a node on the [bold]Analysis Console[/bold] to see its [bold]triggers[/bold] and [bold]effect[/bold]. 2. Perform the listed triggers near the artifact. When correct, the artifact will resonate: [italic]"It begins to shift in strange ways..."[/italic]. - The [bold]Node Scanner[/bold] shows which node ID is being triggered. 3. Once all triggers are met, the artifact activates its effect: [italic]"It slows down, visibly changed."[/italic]. - The node becomes [bold][color=green]Active[/color][/bold] and can now be manually activated.
## Timing - After the first trigger is met, there is a 5 second window to perform the next one. - The timer resets each time a new trigger is completed. - If the timer runs out, the activation fails: [italic]"It slows down before uneventfully stopping."[/italic].
## Order of Triggers - Trigger order does not matter for a single node. - If multiple nodes share a trigger, you may need to use other triggers first to progress.
## Manual Activation - Interacting with the artifact manually activates all [bold]Active[/bold] nodes at once. - This consumes 1 durability from each triggered node.
